factbook.naturalResources: petroleum, phosphates, chrome and manganese ores, asphalt, iron ore, rock salt, marble, gypsum, hydropower
factbook.religions: Muslim 87% (official; includes Sunni 74% and Alawi, Ismaili, and Shia 13%), Christian 10% (includes Orthodox, Uniate, and Nestorian), Druze 3%
factbook.climate: mostly desert; hot, dry, sunny summers (June to August) and mild, rainy winters (December to February) along coast; cold weather with snow or sleet periodically in Damascus
factbook.terrain: primarily semiarid and desert plateau; narrow coastal plain; mountains in west
factbook.independence: 17 April 1946 (from League of Nations mandate under French administration)
factbook.source: CIA World Factbook (public domain) via factbook/factbook.json — not an African primary source
